DECLARE
 ld_sysdate DATE;
 lv_report_status VARCHAR2(15);
 ln_seq NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 IF :CTRL_BLOCK_1.PARM_ID IS NULL OR :CTRL_BLOCK_1.PARM_ID = 'NEW' THEN
 -- New Report ID
 SELECT REP_ID_SEQ.NEXTVAL INTO ln_seq FROM DUAL;
 
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.PARM_ID := :BANNER.USER_ID || '_' || TO_CHAR(:BANNER.HDR_DATE, 'MMDDYY') || '_' || TO_CHAR(ln_seq); 
 
 ELSE
 -- Existing Report ID
 BEGIN
 SELECT report_status INTO lv_report_status
 FROM rpt_parm
 WHERE appl_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.APPL_ID
 AND user_name = :BANNER.USER_ID
 AND report_name = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.REPORT_NAME
 AND parm_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.PARM_ID
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID;
 
 IF NVL(lv_report_status,'X') = 'S' THEN
 message(' Report in progress; Please wait or enter new Report ID');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('Report ID not found in the system');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 MESSAGE('Multiple report jobs found for the same report id');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
 END; 
 
 END IF;

 :system.message_level := '25';
 
 go_block('rpt_parm');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('parm_select');
 clear_block(no_validate);

 

 GO_BLOCK('RPT_PARM');
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0'; 
 
 go_item('CTRL_BLOCK_1.PARM_ID');
 
 :system.message_level := '0'; 
 
 get_parm_def;
END;

declare
 t_date date;
 rpt_chk varchar2(200);
begin
 if :system.record_status not in ('INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 return;
 end if;
--
------------------- parameter must be entered ---------------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select is null
 then
 if :system.cursor_record > 1
 then
 clear_record;
 return;
 else
 message ('Err: Parameter value must be entered ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
------------- change to upper case, if upper case flag = Y -------------
--
 if :parm_def.upper_case_flag = 'Y'
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select := upper(:parm_select.parm_select);
 end if;
--
------------------- skip validation, if paramter = ALL -----------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select = 'ALL'
 then
 return;
 end if;
--
------------------- validate wrt field type ------------------------
--
 if :parm_def.code_type = 'NUMBER'
 then
 begin
 if check_numeric (:system.cursor_value) = FALSE
 then
 message ('Err: Parameter value should be numeric ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'DATE'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 8
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 10
 then
 null;
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RRRR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be MM-DD-YYYY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'DATETM'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 12
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,4) || ' ' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,9,2) || ':' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,11,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 16
 then
 null;
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RRRR HH24:MI');
 exception
 when others then
 message
('Err: Invalid datetime format. Must be MM-DD-YYYY HH:MI');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'ODATE'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 9
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,3) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,6,4);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 11
 then
 null;
 else
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YYYY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'DD-MON-RRRR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YYYY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 end if;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 :parm_select.ref_table := :parm_def.ref_table;
 :parm_select.ref_column := :parm_def.ref_column;
 if :parm_select.ref_table is not null and
 :parm_select.ref_column is not null
 then
 begin
 select decode(instr(:system.cursor_value,'%'),0,'N','Y')
 into :parm_select.wildcard_ind from dual;
 end;
--
 /* user_exit ('rptcheck');
 if form_failure
 then
 if :parm_select.err_msg is null
 then
 :parm_select.err_msg :=
 'Err: Checking paramater wrt ref table';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 message ( :parm_select.err_msg);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;*/
 :system.message_level := '25';
 rpt_chk := rpt_validate(:parm_select.ref_table,:parm_select.ref_column,
 :parm_select.parm_select,:parm_select.wildcard_ind);
 :system.message_level := '10';
 if rpt_chk = 'SUCCESS' then
 --Added on 08/07/2011; Store chapter id in global package variable.
 -- p_global.chapter_id : used in WVI of PARM_SELECT to pass as parameter in CALL_FORM built in
 if :parm_select.ref_table = 'CHAPTERS' and :parm_select.ref_column = 'CHAPTER_ID' then
 :global.parm_chp_id := :parm_select.parm_select;
 end if;
 ----
 else
 show_error('2319');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 group_id recordgroup;
 query_ok NUMBER;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := 'TEST';
 rg_id recordgroup;
 h_query_txt VARCHAR2(535); 
BEGIN
 IF :parm_def.list_form_name IS NOT NULL THEN

 :global.parm_select := NULL;
 
 CALL_FORM( lower(:PARM_DEF.LIST_FORM_NAME) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,QUERY_ONLY);
 if form_failure
 then
 message('Msg: List of values not available for this parameter');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 if :global.parm_select is not null
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select := :global.parm_select;
 end if; 
 
 ELSIF :parm_def.ref_sql IS NOT NULL THEN

 rg_id := FIND_GROUP(rg_name);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF; 
 
 IF :parm_def.lov_limit = 'Y' THEN
 IF LENGTH(:parm_select.parm_select) < 3 THEN
 MESSAGE('11330');PAUSE; --show_error('11330');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 h_query_txt := REPLACE(:parm_def.ref_sql, ':PARM_SELECT.PARM_SELECT', ''''
 || :parm_select.parm_select
 || '''');

 ELSE
 h_query_txt := :parm_def.ref_sql;
 END IF;

 rg_id := create_group_from_query(rg_name, h_query_txt);

 
 query_ok := populate_group(rg_id);
 IF query_ok <> 0 THEN
 message('Msg: Empty list of values');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 set_lov_property('LOV_PARM_SELECT', group_name, rg_id);
 set_lov_property('LOV_PARM_SELECT', title, :parm_def.lov_title);
 set_lov_column_property('LOV_PARM_SELECT', 1, title, nvl(:parm_def.lov_col1_name, 'Code'));

 set_lov_column_property('LOV_PARM_SELECT', 2, title, nvl(:parm_def.lov_col2_name, 'Description'));

 IF NOT show_lov('LOV_PARM_SELECT', 70, 120) THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF; 
 
 ELSE
 MESSAGE('Msg: List of values not available');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
 END IF;
END;

FUNCTION rpt_validate(loc_ref_table IN varchar2,
 loc_ref_column IN varchar2,
 loc_parm_select IN varchar2,
 loc_wildcard_ind IN varchar2)
 RETURN varchar2
 IS
 cur_handle integer;
 loc_chk integer;
 ret_val varchar2(100);
err_num number;
err_msg varchar2(100);
my_error varchar2(100);
sql_stat1 varchar2(100);
sql_stat2 varchar2(100);
my_exception exception;
 BEGIN
 cur_handle := DBMS_SQL.OPEN_CURSOR;
 sql_stat1 := 'SELECT * FROM '||loc_ref_table||' WHERE '||loc_ref_column||'
like '||' '''||loc_parm_select||''' ';
 sql_stat2 := 'SELECT * FROM '||loc_ref_table||' WHERE '||loc_ref_column||'
 = '||' '''||loc_parm_select||''' ';
 -- ret_val := sql_stat;
--raise my_exception;
 if loc_wildcard_ind = 'Y' then
 DBMS_SQL.PARSE(cur_handle,sql_stat1,2);
 else
 DBMS_SQL.PARSE(cur_handle,sql_stat2,2);
 end if;
-- return('inexception'||ret_val);
loc_chk := DBMS_SQL.EXECUTE(cur_handle);
if DBMS_SQL.FETCH_ROWS(cur_handle) = 0 then
 ret_val := 'FAILURE';
 else
 ret_val := 'SUCCESS';
end if;
DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cur_handle);
return(ret_val);
RETURN NULL; exception
when my_exception then
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cur_handle);
 return('inmyexception'||ret_val);
when others then
 DBMS_SQL.CLOSE_CURSOR(cur_handle);
 err_num := SQLCODE;
 err_msg := substr(SQLERRM,1,100);
 my_error := to_char(err_num)||' '||err_msg;
 return('inothersexception'||ret_val||my_error);
END rpt_validate;

 END;
